title: PascalCase regex now requires 4+ char minimum (not documented in comment)
description: text_unit_extractor.py line 1885 regex changed from plan spec ({1,} lower) to {3,} to fix test regression. Plan said 'Camera' (6 char) would match — it does. But 'Body' (4 char, {3,} lowercase = 3) just barely passes. This is correct and tested but the change from original plan spec should be noted.
root_cause: Plan regex `^[A-Z][a-z0-9]+(?:[A-Z][a-z0-9]*)*$` caused false positives on 'Use', 'The', 'See' (3-char words). Fixed to {3,}.
